headline: Bitcoin hovers around $80,000 as oil stays high ahead of a Fed decision Wednesday, and a popular Bitcoin wallet patches a bug that let attackers steal coins.

market.asOf: BTC and SOL read from CoinGecko at about 08:00 UTC Mon 26 Oct (15:00 Bangkok). ETH from a Crypto Times snapshot at 05:50 UTC (12:50 Bangkok). Fear & Greed from alternative.me's index today; CoinMarketCap's index read 43 in a KuCoin morning brief. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 54, Neutral (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index), up from 51 yesterday

stories.title: Bitcoin hovers around $80,000 as oil stays high and traders get careful before the Fed
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped under $80,000 in Asian trading on Monday and has hovered around that level since. Ether and solana are down a little more. Oil eased slightly but is still very high, and Trump said it is "decision time" on Iran. Forced selling from leveraged bets is much smaller than on Saturday.
points: Bitcoin fell nearly 2% to about $79,800 and ether nearly 3% to just above $2,300, while SOL was barely holding $100, per CoinDesk at 04:37 UTC.

Over 24 hours, $138.03M of leveraged positions were forcibly closed, $103.84M of them bets on higher prices, per a KuCoin morning brief using CoinMarketCap data. On Saturday, $404.15M of such bets were closed in just four hours, per The Block.
Brent oil slipped 1.31% to $115.19 a barrel and US crude to $101.83, per India.com, after Brent gained 6% last week.
Trump told Fox: "Do I finish it off, which would be very easy to do, or do I make a deal?" Türkiye Today notes his claims were not independently verified.

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin slips under $80,000 before the Fed

stories.title: Fed week: a hold expected Wednesday, but markets now lean toward a December hike
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday and almost everyone expects no change. But futures markets now put better-than-even odds on a rate rise in December, as high oil prices feed inflation worries. Inflation (PCE) and growth (GDP) data land Thursday, and a large batch of bitcoin options expires Friday.
points: CME FedWatch shows about a 90.6% chance of no change this week. For December, ATFX cites 79.4% odds of a hike, while BeInCrypto cites 68%.

Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) lost $635.6M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct but still took in about $301M over the week, per Farside; The Block puts the week at $304.73M.
PCE inflation is expected at 3.6% a year, up from 3.4%, per Trading Economics.
Friday's options expiry: about $11.1B with "max pain" at $78,000 (CryptoTicker), $10.97B (BeInCrypto), or about $12.3B with max pain at $79,000 (Bitcoin News Digest).

sources.label: BeInCrypto: Fed week and options expiry

stories.title: Security alert: Electrum wallet bug let rogue servers steal bitcoin
stories.summary: Electrum, a long-running Bitcoin wallet, had a flaw that let a malicious server trick the wallet when a user raised the fee to speed up a payment, so the coins went to the attacker instead. Version 4.8.3 fixes it. If you use Electrum, update and check addresses before you sign.
points: Electrum released version 4.8.3 on 24 Oct; earlier versions remain vulnerable when connected to malicious servers, per CoinDesk.
A first report came in on 11 Oct; a user reported losing funds on 18 Oct. Developers have not disclosed the amount stolen, per CoinDesk.
Users who connect only to trusted servers, including their own, were not exposed, per crypto.news citing the advisory.
CoinDesk advises checking receiving addresses and amounts before signing any payment.

briefs.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam test is still on hold
briefs.summary: The Hoodi test-network run of Ethereum's next upgrade, which had been set for today, is postponed with no new date, per Bitcoin Sistemi.

briefs.title: CoinDCX confirms a $16M loss
briefs.summary: The Indian exchange lost 15.99M USDT from retired deposit wallets days after its CEO called breach reports a false alarm, and says the company absorbed the loss, per The Block.

briefs.title: Keystone hardware wallet store breached
briefs.summary: Customer names, contact details and shipping addresses were exposed through its online store. Keystone says recovery phrases and keys were not exposed and warns of scammers posing as the company, per The Block.

briefs.title: Stablecoin supply is shrinking
briefs.summary: Total stablecoin supply has shed $12.73B since 22 May to $300.36B, per DefiLlama data cited by Bitcoin.com News, which notes this does not necessarily mean money left crypto.

briefs.title: Most bitcoin still can't be tied to a known owner
briefs.summary: About 11.1M BTC can't be linked to any known owner even after Wall Street buying, per Galaxy research reported by CoinDesk. The figure may include lost coins.

briefs.title: Hong Kong bank stablecoins reach retail
briefs.summary: HSBC's RedCoin began a phased rollout on 23 Oct to PayMe users, while Standard Chartered-backed Anchorpoint still plans retail access to its HKDAP coin with no date, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Strategy's latest disclosed bitcoin buy
briefs.summary: Its last reported purchase was 267 BTC for $22.1M, taking holdings to 848,517 BTC, per Bitcoin.com News. Strategy reports earnings Thursday.

briefs.title: China court moves to confiscate about 61,900 BTC
briefs.summary: A Tianjin court accepted a request to confiscate 61,896 BTC tied to a $5.7B fraud, starting a six-month notice period, per the Bitcoin News Digest.

Rate 2.75%; a hike to 3.00% is widely expected (about 90% priced per InvestingLive, 98% per Forex.com).
Rate 2.25%. A Reuters poll (via FXStreet) expects a hike to 2.50%.

Range 3.75-4.00%. 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold (Kitco); CME FedWatch showed 90.6% for a hold (BeInCrypto, 25 Oct). Press conference 2:30pm ET (01:30 Bangkok). No new projections at this meeting.

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (advance) and September PCE inflation
calendar.note: GDP: consensus 3.2% (Trading Economics) or 3.0% (Bitcoin Sistemi); prior 2.2%. PCE: 3.6% y/y expected, prior 3.4%; core PCE 3.1% expected, prior 3.0%. Jobless claims: consensus 196,000, prior 194,000. ECB decision at 9:15am ET (20:15 Bangkok): deposit rate 2.50%, hold expected.
Results after the US close; Coinbase Q&A and Strategy webinar at 5:00pm ET. Token unlocks the same day: FF ~$20.1M and CARDS ~$18.2M, per the unlock data on this page.
A hold at 1.25% is expected. No fixed time; it usually comes around midday Tokyo. Governor's press conference 3:30pm Tokyo (13:30 Bangkok).
At 08:00 UTC. About $11.1B with max pain at $78,000 (CryptoTicker), $10.97B (BeInCrypto), or about $12.3B with max pain at $79,000 (Bitcoin News Digest). Max pain is not a price target.
